Commissions — No. 01

Commissions

Site-specific work in cement, plaster, and steel — developed with architects, designers, and private collectors from first sketch to final install. Interior or exterior, one piece or a full program.

Every commission begins with a conversation about the space, the aesthetic, and the experience the finished piece is meant to create.

Commissioned work can be found in private collections, hospitality, and commercial spaces across the country.  Every commission is unique, inspired by its setting and built to endure.

02

The process

01 — Consultation

A conversation about the site, scale, and use — in person or by video, with reference material from prior work.

02 — Concept

A direction, material palette, and quote — refined until the form, vision, and budget align.

03 — Fabrication

Designed, created, and finished in studio — with progress photos shared as the piece develops.

04 — Install

Delivered and installed on site throughout the U.S. and internationally.
